scope: Broader cross-implementation research to refine the DWG/DXF implementation plan, with focus on capability evidence levels, OBJECTS graph boundaries, CLASSES metadata, and pre-emission readiness

method.kind: static primary-source, official-format-reference, and local-source review
method.sourceBranches: LibreDWG/master, LibreCAD/LibreCAD master, ACadSharp/master, and ezdxf stable/master are mutable references; citations identify reviewed pages and do not pin an immutable source snapshot
method.principle: Autodesk DXF and ODA DWG references establish format contracts; peer code/docs/issues are implementation cross-checks and do not independently qualify libdxfrw semantics

crossImplementationFindings.evidence: The project manual self-reports approximately 99% DWG coverage across R1.2-R2018 but separately lists R2007 DWG writing as unavailable, TABLESTYLE as working only pre-2010, and multiple classes as unstable/undertested. Closed issue #1107 preserves a historical conversion log with TABLESTYLE unhandled and MATERIAL/MLEADERSTYLE warnings; the issue's closed state prevents treating that log as proof of current-master failure.
crossImplementationFindings.planUse: Use family/version-specific values and output warnings/skips, not project percentages or a successful file-open, as differential evidence. The historical issue is a warning-pattern example only.

crossImplementationFindings.evidence: Its published matrix separately lists DXF reader/writer and DWG reader/writer capabilities by file version. Reader usage exposes notification callbacks. A version-matrix cell or successful document construction does not establish retention/emission of a specific OBJECTS family.
crossImplementationFindings.planUse: Keep optional differential runs family-scoped and record exact source/output inventory plus notification and unsupported/skipped-object details. No mandatory runtime/dependency is added.

crossImplementationFindings.evidence: Unknown/unsupported DXF records can be preserved as TagStorage without semantic support. The OBJECTS documentation states that extension dictionaries and graphical-entity XRECORDs may reside outside the NOD tree. The XREF route supports a bounded dependency subset and documents unsupported objects/features.
crossImplementationFindings.planUse: Keep raw retention, typed interpretation, root reachability, and whole-object-graph closure separate. Inventory owner/reactor/xDict/reference edges in addition to NOD traversal; do not use raw save success or XREF copying as whole-conversion proof. This confirms existing graph policy rather than adding a new graph root.

crossImplementationFindings.evidence: The generated inventory explicitly says it is a deterministic source inventory, not byte-level conformance evidence; it distinguishes typed/raw/unsupported routes and marks rows fixture-needed. The header exposes a broad set of per-family DXF writer methods, including the named resource and visual-style candidates.
crossImplementationFindings.planUse: Use the in-tree fork as a route/field/test-design reference for convergence, not a semantic qualification source. Port a narrow vertical family slice and verify locally rather than equating type/API counts with demonstrated support.

formatContractReconciliation.evidence: Autodesk's published CLASSES table calls both group 1 (DXF record name) and group 2 (C++ class name) always unique. ezdxf documentation retains a historical empirical note that some Architectural Desktop 2007 files reused group 1 with differing group 2 values. Local preflight currently enforces uniqueness for each field.
formatContractReconciliation.decision: Keep the standards-based fail-closed uniqueness rule; do not relax it based solely on the conflicting peer note. If a producer-authored counterexample is collected, bind its product/version/hash and reconcile against the exact target contract before changing policy.
formatContractReconciliation.classInstanceCount: Autodesk identifies group 91 as the custom-class instance count. Local DXF writing validates/freezes and emits CLASSES before OBJECTS, so planned typed/raw class output and AC1018+ counts must be computed before dxfRW::write(), after dedup and refusal decisions; source counts are not output counts. Fixed MLINESTYLE does not require a CLASS record.

localFindings.evidence: The writer preflights/finalizes DXF class metadata and emits the CLASSES section before writeObjects. Its preflight rejects duplicate record names and duplicate C++ class names. Therefore adding callbacks/writers alone cannot compute reliable group-91 counts during object emission.
localFindings.readiness: F.4b needs a final admitted-output class manifest prepared before writer entry; class registration/count assertions belong in the fast generated ASCII/binary output/readback checks.

localFindings.evidence: The adapter already computes output class counts for selected ACDS/evaluation-graph routes, while generic copied class metadata is otherwise passed through. New typed named-resource routes need explicit class/count planning after raw/typed dedup and before dxfRW::write().
localFindings.readiness: Reuse the established adapter preflight location and existing class APIs rather than adding a late writer mutation path.

implementationPlanChanges.f3c: Unchanged: exact source/profile/payload admission remains required before typed VisualStyle output.
implementationPlanChanges.f4b0: Add immutable target custom-CLASS manifest and class identity/count checks to the field/origin/reference/loss matrix.
implementationPlanChanges.f4b1a: Compute class registrations and AC1018+ instance counts from final admitted SCALE/DICTIONARYVAR output before CLASSES emission; include ASCII/binary parse-back count checks.
implementationPlanChanges.f4b1c: Compute MLEADERSTYLE class count from the final admitted output set before CLASSES emission, with the existing AC1021/AC1024/AC1027 payload gates.
implementationPlanChanges.graph: Retain explicit separation of NOD traversal from owner/reactor/xDict/reference graph census; no new object-graph policy is inferred from peers.
